name: I14Y
documentComment:
This SBOM enumerates every unique (name, version) package tuple across the I14Y frontend (npm, both UIs) and backend (NuGet, full solution).
Human-readable third-party license inventories with SPDX identifiers, license URLs, and per-scope tables are maintained alongside this file:
- THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md (direct dependencies, one row per package)
- THIRD-PARTY-TRANSITIVE-LICENSES.md (transitive dependencies)
Relationship modeling: frontend (npm) parent-child dependency edges ARE derived from the package-lock.json resolution graph of both UIs, so npm DEPENDS_ON edges reflect real parent-child linkage.
Relationship modeling limitation: backend (NuGet) parent-child edges are NOT derived, because the mandatory inventory command `dotnet list backend/i14y.slnx package --include-transitive --format json` emits a flat per-project list without parent linkage. All transitive NuGet packages are therefore attached to the root repository package via DEPENDS_ON as a fallback. Consumers MUST NOT infer that every NuGet package attached to the root is a direct dependency of I14Y; direct vs. transitive classification is preserved in the two Markdown files above and in the tmp/ evidence artifacts.
